io.milvus.v2.service

Class BaseService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.BaseService
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    CDCService, CollectionService, DatabaseService, IndexService, PartitionService, RBACService, ResourceGroupService, SnapshotService, UtilityService, VectorService

    public class BaseService
extends Object
    Base service for the Milvus v2 clients. Provides shared utilities and cache management for the domain-specific service classes.
